Components / Message

Message

One turn. The prop is `from`, not `role`. Markdown is INJECTED via renderMarkdown and defaults to plain Text, which keeps the core Expo Go-clean.

  • v0.2.1
  • component
  • nativewind
  • uniwind
  • runs in Expo Go

Install

npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/nativewind/message.json
npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/uniwind/message.json

Dependencies

No required npm packages — this item installs through the registry dependencies below.

https://reactnativereusables.com/r/nativewind/avatar.json
https://reactnativereusables.com/r/nativewind/text.json
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hackerpug-ai/rnr-ai-elements/v0.2.1/public/r/nativewind/markdown.json
https://reactnativereusables.com/r/uniwind/avatar.json
https://reactnativereusables.com/r/uniwind/text.json
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hackerpug-ai/rnr-ai-elements/v0.2.1/public/r/uniwind/markdown.json

Theming

Themed via bg-secondary, text-foreground, bg-primary, text-primary-foreground, bg-muted, text-muted-foreground.

Usage

(o) => ( <Message from={(o.from as 'user' | 'assistant') ?? 'assistant'}> <Text className="text-sm text-foreground"> The 56-item set installs through the real RNR CLI at Expo 57 pins. </Text> </Message> )

The TextClassContext seam

This component publishes its class strings through the TextClassContext provider, so a parent view can restyle its nested text.

Theming guide: The TextClassContext seam

The renderMarkdown seam

This component takes a renderMarkdown prop over the react-native-enriched-markdown native module and defaults to plain text.

Theming guide: The renderMarkdown seam
